title: MZ Shaz port; Looping Map Animation?

posts.author: Allusion
posts.body:
Hi, everyone! Shaz made
a really cool plugin for RPG Maker MV
that allows animations to loop on the map; I wondered if anyone could port it to MZ?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Can't do it LOL, but a question: is there a reason you can't just use a parallel event playing the animation on the event? If you need the functionality of showing the animation below the event, you could search/ask for that.

posts.author: Allusion
posts.body: Lag, mainly lol! I have 1 parallel event running at all times to perform a quick party-switch feature on the map, plus the animations that loop would be on enemies all over the map! QAQ
